note_en: 看不懂 ("can't make sense of it") is a potential complement: verb + 不 + result says whether an action can reach its outcome. 看 is "look" and 懂 is "understand," so 菜单上全是她看不懂的文字 means she looked but couldn't understand; the positive form is 看得懂. English needs a separate "can't" plus a verb, while Chinese builds the ability into the verb itself, as also in 翻译不出 "can't be translated" and 读不懂 "can't make out."
